description: Turn a table of task examples into a JSONL evaluation set and a scoring rubric. When you have labelled examples and need an eval set and rubric. Do not choose this when you need synthetic examples generated, which needs a model. Example requests: Build an eval dataset from these examples. | Turn this table of task examples into a JSONL eval set. | Make an evaluation set and rubric for this task.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

examples.description: The customer's examples.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row. One example per row. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

task_description.description: The customer's task.txt, as text. Supported: Free text. What the model should do. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_eval_dataset_builder
title: Evaluation dataset builder
